items.title: Single-photo feed posts remain static on hover
items.precondition: A contained authenticated runtime has a regular feed post with exactly one uploaded photo.
steps: At desktop width, hover the photo and observe its bounds before, during, and after hover.
Tab to the post photo link and activate it with the keyboard.
Repeat the hover observation at a narrow mobile viewport using a hover-capable pointer, where available.
items.expected: The image does not scale, translate, or animate on hover; its post-detail navigation and keyboard focus/activation continue to work.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: product owner confirmed this UI acceptance item passed after testing the implemented change.
items.notes: User-confirmed acceptance; navigation and keyboard focus were included in the checklist.

items.title: Multi-photo feed grids remain static on hover
items.precondition: A contained authenticated runtime has feed posts with 2, 3, and 4+ uploaded photos.
steps: At desktop width, hover every visible cell in 2-, 3-, and 4+-photo grids.
Confirm the final cell of a 4+-photo grid keeps its +N overlay.
Activate each grid link and confirm it opens the same post photos destination.
items.expected: No grid image scales, translates, or animates on hover; grid geometry, the +N overlay, and post-photos navigation remain unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: product owner confirmed this UI acceptance item passed after testing the implemented change.
items.notes: User-confirmed acceptance; grids, +N overlays, and navigation were included in the checklist.

items.title: Type, build, lint, and convention gates
steps: Search both target components for residual hover-scale or transform-transition classes on post-media images.
Run npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm --prefix frontend run lint, and npm run check:conventions when available.
Fix execution-caused failures and record any pre-existing or unavailable check with evidence.
items.expected: No targeted hover-animation class remains and no execution-caused type, build, lint, or convention failure remains.
items.evidence: 2026-08-20: targeted audit found no remaining hover:scale, group-hover:scale, or transition-transform class in PostCard.tsx or PostMediaGallery.tsx. npm run typecheck and npm run build passed. npm --prefix frontend run lint exited 0 with six pre-existing warnings in PostDetailPage.tsx, MessageQuoteStrip.tsx, PostPhotoCommentsPage.tsx, AuthContext.tsx, and ThemeContext.tsx.
items.notes: No component-specific automated test file exists. npm run check:conventions is unavailable because package.json defines no such script; this is recorded, not treated as a pass.
items.waiver: Convention gate unavailable: the repository has no check:conventions package script.
